selection: Enumerate every globally rejected but observed-input-supported compiled path in the frozen PlanBench-XL retail relation. Pair it with every distinct two-call original chain sharing its external input and output types, provided the replacement path's first intermediate type differs from the original consumer input. Do not select on executor outcomes.
unit: Original two-call workflow, replacement path, and distinct observed input
comparators: Producer-only replacement retaining the original consumer
Joint two-node structural repair without value certification
Joint two-node repair with global certificate
Joint two-node repair with observed-input certificate
primary_checks: Compatibility and least changed region returned by the existing joint tree solver
Native-executor output equality to the original two-call workflow where defined
Unsafe admissions among unsupported input values
interpretation: An exploratory component-integration replay on compositional tool workflows, not an online agent task trial or an independently held-out benchmark.
